newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices held steady in late trading on Friday on moderate demand ahead of the weekend, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,415 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at 1,420 rupiah.

The traders said crude palm oil was done at an equivalent of 1,215 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in Medan, at 1,207/kg rupiah at a second tender for a similar amount and at 1,204.5 rupiah/kg at a third tender for 2,000 tonnes.
The prices compare with the winning bid of 1,215 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in Medan on Thursday.
"It will be interesting to see which of the prices the market will follow from next week," one trader said. "There are some people who still seem to be short of oil."
Traders said they expected olein prices to trend steady to higher next week on fresh buying and as they continue to adjust to crude palm oil prices.
